# spacelift_azure_integration_consent (Resource)

`spacelift_azure_integration_consent` records externally granted Azure admin consent in Spacelift. Create this resource after granting consent in Azure, for example with `azuread_service_principal_delegated_permission_grant`. It does not grant or verify permissions in Azure. Deleting this resource clears Spacelift's consent confirmation and prevents the integration from being used; it does not revoke the Azure consent grant or delete the service principal. The caller needs permission to confirm or clear consent in the integration's space, or the Space admin role. This resource requires a Spacelift version supporting the `azureIntegrationConsentConfirm` and `azureIntegrationConsentClear` GraphQL mutations. Use this resource's `admin_consent_provided` attribute for outputs during the first apply, because the parent integration's consent status may not refresh until the next plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "azure_tenant_id" {
  description = "Microsoft Entra tenant in which to install the Spacelift enterprise application."
  type        = string
}

variable "azure_subscription_id" {
  description = "Default Azure subscription for the Spacelift integration."
  type        = string
}

variable "name" {
  description = "Name of the Azure integration in Spacelift."
  type        = string
  default     = "Azure integration"
}

variable "space_id" {
  description = "Spacelift space in which to create the integration."
  type        = string
  default     = "root"
}

data "azuread_application_published_app_ids" "well_known" {}

data "azuread_service_principal" "microsoft_graph" {
  client_id = data.azuread_application_published_app_ids.well_known.result.MicrosoftGraph
}

resource "spacelift_azure_integration" "example" {
  name                    = var.name
  space_id                = var.space_id
  tenant_id               = var.azure_tenant_id
  default_subscription_id = var.azure_subscription_id
}

resource "azuread_service_principal" "spacelift" {
  client_id = spacelift_azure_integration.example.application_id
}

resource "azuread_service_principal_delegated_permission_grant" "admin_consent" {
  service_principal_object_id          = azuread_service_principal.spacelift.object_id
  resource_service_principal_object_id = data.azuread_service_principal.microsoft_graph.object_id
  claim_values                         = ["User.Read"]
}

resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "spacelift" {
  scope                = "/subscriptions/${var.azure_subscription_id}"
  role_definition_name = "Contributor"
  principal_id         = azuread_service_principal.spacelift.object_id
  principal_type       = "ServicePrincipal"

  # The new service principal may not yet have replicated to Azure Resource Manager.
  skip_service_principal_aad_check = true
}

resource "spacelift_azure_integration_consent" "example" {
  integration_id = spacelift_azure_integration.example.id

  depends_on = [azuread_service_principal_delegated_permission_grant.admin_consent]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) ID of the Azure integration whose admin consent has been granted

### Read-Only

- `admin_consent_provided` (Boolean) Indicates whether Spacelift has recorded admin consent for the integration
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import spacelift_azure_integration_consent.example $INTEGRATION_ID
```
